## Definitions worth quoting

**GEO (Generative Engine Optimization):** the practice of getting a brand
surfaced and cited inside AI-generated answers on ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google
AI Overviews, rather than only in traditional blue-link search results. Answer
engines pull from structured, verifiable, entity-rich content, so the work
centres on schema markup, entity signals, direct answer formatting, and crawler
configuration.

**GEO compared with classic SEO:** classic SEO competes for a position in a
list of links. GEO competes to be the source a model quotes inside its answer.
There is no rank to track, so citations and share of answer replace position.
The unit that gets pulled is a passage rather than a page, so each section has
to answer one question on its own. Entity clarity outweighs link volume. The
technical foundations overlap almost completely: crawlability, schema, speed
and clean structure serve both.

**How a brand gets cited by ChatGPT or Perplexity:** answer the question in the
first two sentences of a section, mark the page up so a machine can tell a
person from a product from a service, publish claims a model can check with
named sources and dated numbers, allow GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and
ClaudeBot in robots.txt, and publish an llms.txt brief.

## Selected SEO and GEO engagements

- **Jidoka Technologies** (Vision AI for manufacturing, 6 months). Competitor
  research first, then 240+ AI-SEO posts mapped to real use cases: defect
  detection, kitting, label verification, process optimisation. Result: 700%
  organic traffic increase and lead generation across multiple countries.
- **Ohh My Brand** (ongoing freelance). Cleanup before content. Audited every
  existing post against traffic, rankings and intent, removed 60 scraped or
  non-ranking posts, delivered one full traffic audit, then built the production
  pipeline and shipped 150+ new AI-SEO posts in a single consistent voice.
- **Ariel Software Solutions** (B2B software, 10 weeks). One competitor research
  report to find where rivals had claimed topical ground, then 50+ SEO and GEO
  optimised posts in under a month. Traffic climbed and the company appeared in
  international search results for the first time. Exact percentage pending.
